The '''TT-15A Powertech''' was a type of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] heavily used by both it's creators the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] and elite [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] who either earned the armor as a reward or had the credits to afford buying the set during both the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]]. Some Mandalorians and others still continued using the set during the [[war against Zakuul]].
